subject: [PATCH 4/4] kernfs: Remove kernfs_rwsem from dentry revalidation

reviews.author: Sandeep Dhavale
reviews.summary:
reviewer expressed skepticism about removing kernfs_rwsem without a reliable reproducer, requesting proof that it is needed before adding a check

Reviewer Sandeep Dhavale expressed skepticism about the suspected call chain that leads to dentry->d_inode = NULL, specifically under memory pressure conditions when a userspace component reads CMA stats through sysfs, and requested more evidence before considering any changes.
reviews.raw_body:
Hi Shakeel,
No luck with the reproducer yet, and reports have been sporadic.

---

Ok, I understand. Do you have any opinion on the suspected call chain
which makes dentry->d_inode = NULL; ?
Partner report said it happens under memory pressure, and userspace
component was reading the CMA stats through
sysfs [1]. So I naturally looked at the shrinker and suspected that
call chain, which made sense for my 6.12 kernel call stack.

Thanks,
Sandeep.
[1] https://cs.android.com/android/platform/superproject/+/android-latest-release:system/memory/libmeminfo/sysmeminfo.cpp;l=545?q=sysme&ss=android%2Fplatform%2Fsuperproject

reviews.author: Shakeel Butt (author)
reviews.summary: Author responded to Sandeep's concern that reclaim can set dentry->d_inode = NULL for a dentry with an elevated lockref count, explaining that kernfs_dop_revalidate gets the dentry whose lockref count is elevated and therefore skips such dentries.
reviews.raw_body:
I don't see how reclaim can set dentry->d_inode = NULL for a dentry with
elevated dentry->d_lockref.count because kernfs_dop_revalidate gets the dentry
whose dentry->d_lockref.count is elevated. Reclaim specifically skips such
dentries.

reviews.author: Sandeep Dhavale
reviews.summary: reviewer requested a reproducer before considering the patch, citing inability to reproduce memory stress issue
reviews.raw_body:
Thank you for your input! That may explain why I am unable to reproduce led by
memory stress narrative. Let me attempt to reproduce this first and I
will provide an update.

Thanks again,
Sandeep.

2026-09-11.patch_summary: This patch removes the kernfs_rwsem lock from dentry revalidation, addressing an issue where the lock was causing unnecessary contention and potential deadlocks in certain scenarios.
